description: Get the current iteration context (Current + Backlog) for AI planning. Each story carries a derived `reviewStatus` (awaiting_review | accepted | changes_requested | in_progress | unstarted) so you can filter "which of mine are awaiting review?" from one field instead of decoding the (state, workflow_stage) tuple — it respects the workspace's workflow model (3-state vs 4-state). The response also includes a `countsByStatus` rollup. Returns a lean, camelCase-only story shape by default (description + acceptance criteria omitted) so large boards stay within the token cap. Pass view:"summary" for just id/title/points/state/workflowStage/lane/epicId/reviewStatus, or include:["description","acceptanceCriteria"] to opt the heavy fields back in.

backlogLimit.description: Max backlog stories returned (default 25, ordered by priority; current iteration is never capped). Response always carries backlogTotal/backlogShowing so truncation is visible. Pass 0 for the full backlog.

include.description: Heavy fields to add back to the default shape. Ignored when view:"summary".

view.description: summary → minimal { id, title, points, state, workflowStage, lane, epicId }. Omit (or "full") for the default lean shape (all camelCase fields except description/acceptanceCriteria).

name: get_iteration_context
